competitions.name: Shloka Pathan (Recitation)
competitions.description: Recite selected chapters and shlokas from the Bhagavad Geeta with clear pronunciation, correct meter, and devotion.
competitions.eligibility: Open to all age groups (Categories: Children, Youth, Adults)
rules: Participants must memorize the assigned chapters.
Evaluation will be based on clarity, pronunciation (Uchcharan), and rhythm (Laya).
Time limit per participant is 5 minutes.

competitions.name: Geeta Maha Quiz
competitions.description: A comprehensive quiz testing your knowledge on the philosophy, characters, and core teachings of the Bhagavad Geeta.
rules: First round will be a written multiple-choice test.
Top 10 scorers will move to the live rapid-fire stage.
Use of any reference material during the quiz is strictly prohibited.

competitions.name: Essay Writing Competition
competitions.description: Express your thoughts on how the timeless teachings of the Geeta apply to modern-day challenges and youth.
rules: Topics will be provided 24 hours in advance.
Submissions must be original. Plagiarized content will be immediately disqualified.

competitions.name: Geeta Chitra Kala (Poster Making)
competitions.description: Visually depict a prominent scene, concept, or moral from the Bhagavad Geeta through art and colors.
rules: Standard A3 drawing sheets will be provided at the venue.
Participants must bring their own art supplies (crayons, watercolors, pencils).

competitions.name: Elocution (Vaktutva Spardha)
competitions.description: Deliver an impactful speech on the topic 'Karma Yoga: The Secret of Work' based on Geeta's teachings.
rules: Speech can be delivered in English, Hindi, or Sanskrit.
Time limit per speaker is 3 to 5 minutes.
Points will be awarded for content clarity, confidence, and articulation.
